reason: Single-world ARC shards incorrectly applied an ensemble-level degeneracy fraction gate, so any treated world inside the near-zero band was interpreted as 100% degenerate and aborted.

Windowed command-service telemetry subtracts independently accumulated cumulative supported and indigenous totals. Floating-point cancellation could create a tiny negative external increment even though the mathematical quantity is nonnegative in the Lean Nat domain.

degeneracy_gate.old_behavior: The Rust runner enforced the >90% near-zero and variance alarms independently inside each one-world ARC shard.
degeneracy_gate.new_behavior: Single-world ARC shards emit diagnostics but defer enforcement. The unchanged >90% near-zero and variance thresholds are enforced by the shard merger after the complete 720-world ensemble is assembled.

formal_command_external_projection.old_behavior: external_command_service = supported_interval_service - indigenous_interval_service was passed directly to the strict formal adapter.
formal_command_external_projection.new_behavior: A negative residual no larger than 1e-10 times max(|supported|, |indigenous|, 1) is projected to zero before entering the strict formal adapter. Material negative discrepancies remain negative and are rejected.

merge_provenance.new_behavior: The merger verifies every task metadata sidecar, primary and trajectory SHA-256, task id, discovery mode, and CSV git_commit before merging, and records source array job ids.

rationale: Any original shard that encountered a negative formal external-service value failed before producing a completed metadata sidecar; therefore every preserved completed shard used a nonnegative value that the new projection returns unchanged.
The degeneracy change only suppresses an abort for single-world shards. A preserved completed shard necessarily did not trigger that abort under the original runner.
The merger change has no effect on simulation execution or shard contents.
required_provenance: Preserved shards must retain source commit d2b317a8846fa233f4afa1eccf86add4b906e1a1 and source array job 882437 in task metadata.
Resumed shards must record their amended source commit and resumed Slurm array job in task metadata.
All 720 metadata sidecars and primary/trajectory SHA-256 values must validate before analysis.

formal_failure_world.original_failure: formal service external must be nonnegative (Lean domain is Nat)
